convention: The same three-state convention as messages/lg.needs-translation.json, for the Payments namespace. Translated: the Luganda value differs from the English one. Awaiting a translator: the Luganda file holds the ENGLISH text verbatim and the dotted path is listed under needsTranslation. Identical on purpose: the text is a brand name and reads the same in both languages, and the path is listed under identicalOnPurpose. src/i18n/i18n.test.ts checks only the BASE catalogues, so nothing enforces this file; it is a worklist for a translator, not a gate.
why: The agent that wrote this namespace does not speak Luganda. On a payment screen a confident-sounding wrong translation is not a cosmetic defect: the distance between "nothing has been paid yet" and "you have paid" is the distance between a patient waiting and a patient paying a second time for one consultation — and Carevelo holds nothing to refund the duplicate from, so the clinic has to unpick it by hand through its own aggregator. An honest English string a reader can recognise as foreign and ask about is the safer failure.
translateFirst: Payments.waiting.doNotPayTwice and Payments.unresolved.doNotPayTwice — the one sentence standing between an uncertain patient and a second collection.

Payments.waiting.notPaidYet, Payments.waiting.howLong and Payments.notStarted.bodyAggregator — the honest wait. Each of them says that nothing has been paid yet, which is the claim the PRD forbids getting wrong.
Payments.refunds.body and Payments.refunds.how — why there is no refund button. Left in English this reads as an unfinished feature rather than as an instruction to telephone the clinic.
Payments.status.* — six words that stand for the state of somebody’s money, and that appear on their own in a badge with no sentence around them to disambiguate.
doNotTranslate: Payments.failed.saidBy names the provider and introduces a quotation. The QUOTATION itself is the aggregator's own text, arriving on the PaymentIntent resource rather than from this catalogue, and it is rendered verbatim in whatever language the aggregator sent it. It must never be translated, paraphrased or tidied — only the aggregator knows why a collection failed, and the difference between insufficient funds and a wrong PIN is the difference between two actions for the person holding the handset.
